title: LibraryDiffOutput
description: Output of `gentry library diff --json`: the subagents of the library directory that differ from the active library.

dir.description: Absolute path of the library directory.

applied.description: The commit that applied the active library; absent if the library has never been applied.

changes.description: Changed subagents by identifier. Not empty: without changes there is no draft.

id.description: Identifier of the subagent, the name of its files.

sync.description: What the synchronization of the command did; present only when there is something to tell.
